text.db8bf54b7e2fa6:
** How does it work? **
Personality roles allow the member to choose how he or she wishes to participate in this community. You can select an option and change it later if you wish and the server allows the changes.
The member reacts with the emoji of the chosen option to obtain the role associated with that emoji. You can only keep one election at a time. The choice expresses your interest and offers a personalized experience; you can unlock channels based on the permissions of the roles, but it is neither a proof of identity nor a substitute for age verification.

** Obligation and re-entry**
If verification is enabled and mandatory, anyone who fails to define their identity within the set time limit will be automatically kicked. Before the kick El Heraldo attempts to send a message with a one-time invitation: a re-entry opportunity to complete the election. The purpose is to distinguish those who wish to participate, without attributing intentions to anyone. The moderators and the owner are exempt. If deactivated or optional, there is no kick for not choosing.

**Access authorisations**
Roles can allow View channel on specific channels. It also checks inherited permissions for categories and other roles. The bot retains the existing roles by activating or deactivating.

Personality roles let members choose how they would like to participate in this community. Members can choose one option; this server does not allow them to change it while changes are disabled.

Members react with the emoji for their chosen option to receive the associated role. They can keep only one choice at a time.

The choice expresses their interests and provides a personalized experience in the server. It may unlock channels according to role permissions; it is not proof of identity and does not replace age verification.
